## Who and why

The owner, 2026-11-23, about 17:10 UTC, first-hand: "I'd like everything to utilized the approved assets in the drive. If there is anything for which there is no approved asset. Start a list of those in the drive that is properly routed so it can be found and worked on."

Filed by Claude (orchestrator), 2026-11-23. Claude checked every asset the game draws or plays (210 in all) against the approved Drive material: the [A00 owner-endorsed comps](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1ejWvlQBo85YiC_5dsTxZFZugwFxKS1pB), P01 (importable prototype files), the P03, P04, P05, P07 and P08 source plates ([P03](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1m5KXh8Ts-UiMWS6Us9qaA6MlucsTHpGf), [P04](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1CwqUK750arthkFGMfsK3yRiJ6lzlRfrW), [P07](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1PQO3UB9JbT8R5LPs6u66Nzz1JHgAHXB-), [P08](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1e1RmSNHr-VzCkSAVOJEbW8E9URTkrhsD)), [doc 36's canon heroes](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1p_kXnoB_9gClFaR47U6-ige5I-9hs1Ta9s-thwSwF9g/edit) and the [ASSET LIBRARY — START HERE (Claude)](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1bnr7GUgrYBVVY0BMkwx4qRPvW45Nk4grn-Tk6THcoY8/edit). The game already uses approved art for 81 of them; approved sources exist for another 102, which Claude's art lanes will cut from those plates. This list holds only the 27 needs that no approved asset covers. Approved plates that still need extraction or cleanup are Claude's work and are not listed here.

## How to use this list

ChatGPT:

1.  Take items top-down: the work order below is the priority order. MA-01 first.
2.  Before making anything, check the [ASSET LIBRARY — START HERE](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1bnr7GUgrYBVVY0BMkwx4qRPvW45Nk4grn-Tk6THcoY8/edit) and the [Master Board](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1rzixv5r4QWs7PKLYJ0e_sreLy0LjTdgua8uXKeTJpSE/edit) for the item's ID. If something approved already covers it, say so in the item's row and link it instead of drawing a new one.
3.  Deliver per the [Asset Request Protocol](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1oBpJKI2P7v7rwoMku-TbcFuVQe2iajddK6v2i5Ro0G0/edit): real files uploaded to the right batch folder under [03 Visual Direction and Assets](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/14_W7PwMV8nmRRTSo5FB6_gtih3V4j8Y-) (sounds under [Audio](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Wi9oUAPv_c6noytThA8Js5h2JfqE91P1)), read back the file IDs, meet the [visual quality gate](https://docs.google.com/document/d/17OlSfBfTnUEUTmbo-zcsl4VrSn1mPny-zAP6kZaiodU/edit), and for any face follow [doc 35](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1W1rOej7YL6MGcvwZfbpBTBqMyMz9Q_O2zpLNCZ2XNL8/edit). Look at the "Start from" images in each row first.
4.  Mark each item DELIVERED in this Doc: change its Status cell to DELIVERED with direct file links, and add a line to the Fulfilment log at the bottom. Leave items you have not finished as REQUESTED; if blocked, write NEEDS CLARIFICATION and the exact blocker in its row.
5.  Add or refresh the item's [Master Board](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1rzixv5r4QWs7PKLYJ0e_sreLy0LjTdgua8uXKeTJpSE/edit) row (new IDs marked "new row" below are proposals: check the ID is still free, then add it), list the files in the [Asset Library](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1bnr7GUgrYBVVY0BMkwx4qRPvW45Nk4grn-Tk6THcoY8/edit), and log the delivery in the root [changelog](https://docs.google.com/document/d/17R7aKkqDxQwRk-cmywQbvQ_CcEzz4UqHz37YYYRnADs/edit).
6.  Items already asked for in another request (A02-01) are delivered under that request. Mark them here too; do not make them twice.
7.  This Doc stays in [01 REQUESTS](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1m2vTlbSVoPJg5TwESbcWH4xoCcSOIKCp) until every item is DELIVERED; then move it to [02 DELIVERED](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/15X6uq3YK-NdKbQQt0FqaXY46msSW38Jm).

Claude: re-syncs the design library, finds the DELIVERED items, integrates them into the game, and adds any new gap found later as the next MA number.

## Style for every item

- The chibi canon family of [doc 36](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1p_kXnoB_9gClFaR47U6-ige5I-9hs1Ta9s-thwSwF9g/edit): the P03 hero sheet and the A00 comps are the look to match. Follow [SOP 34](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1SinRhkiHFGlbZfsvYziXlSlVxerQG7J2vSgl3KxlWVo/edit) and the [style lock](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1TYZcSUJ6pRxWCp76f2mrvwAAz90PRCYVRAWiejmJFFI/edit).
- 16 px tiles; the game is drawn at 320x180 and scaled up by whole numbers on an iPhone.
- True transparency: real alpha in the PNG (hard 0/255 for art), never a painted checkerboard or a coloured ground.
- 1 px ink outline, 3-4 tones per material, the master palette. No letters or digits unless the item is lettering.
- Original work. Never revive anything the library marks REJECTED, OFF-STYLE or SUPERSEDED (Superseded Style Explorations, P06 drift, C02 v1 heroes).
